summary: Iteration 3 retest of iteration-2 fixes. Backend: 9/9 tests pass (2 Groq analyze calls used: one en, one hi). FIX 1: new rows persisted via the ml_features fallback; list, detail and CSV return evidence_verdict.verdict and lang, with no ai_explanation and nothing left inside ml_features. History badges show 'Likely real'/'Likely fake' for new rows and 'No verdict saved' for old rows ('Not enough evidence' count was 0). FIX 2: share sheet shows share-error-text in 0.8s and hides Create (only Cancel is shown). GET/POST share returns 503 database_update_required. FIX 3: the PDF embeds NotoSansDevanagari and extracted text contains Devanagari. FIX 4: /api/ready returns 200 live and 503 when auth_health is monkeypatched to False. FIX 5: Export and Clear all are 44px tall (EN and ES); language rows are 44px and readable; the low-reliability warning is visible; History dates switch to the Spanish locale and back to English. One new bug: header-back-button on /reset-password does nothing on a direct load such as an email link (GO_BACK not handled).

minor.issue: Fallback insert retries on ANY ApiError (network/RLS/etc.), not only on a missing column (PGRST204). Unrelated failures get a second insert attempt and extra latency. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:256

ui_bugs.issue: router.back() is a no-op when there is no navigation history. This is the real case for the password-reset email link. Console: "The action 'GO_BACK' was not handled by any navigator". The user is stuck on the page. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/Screen.tsx:84

issues: Created date uses new Date().toLocaleString() (browser locale), so it stays '11/19/2026, 12:46:39 PM' when the app language is Spanish. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AnalysisView.tsx:31

Date format is hard-coded 'MMM D, YYYY HH:mm'. Month names are localized ('nov 19, 2026'), but the order stays English. Consider dayjs localizedFormat ('lll') for es/fr/hi/gu. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/history.tsx:119
The error message shown to end users includes developer instructions ('Run supabase/002_verdict_share.sql in the Supabase SQL Editor'). Consider a user-friendly message.

action_items: Fix header-back-button: use router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/sign-in' or '/analyze') (Screen.tsx:84). This affects reset-password from the email link and any deep-linked screen.
Use the app locale for the Analysis details date (AnalysisView.tsx:31), e.g. dayjs(...).format('lll') with the localizedFormat plugin. Consider the same for History.
Narrow the analyze fallback-insert condition to the missing-column error (server.py:256).
Still pending (expected): apply supabase/002_verdict_share.sql in Supabase so that sharing works.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/.env only has MONGO_URL/DB_NAME. SUPABASE_*/GROQ_API_KEY reach gunicorn only through the process environment. The test helper read them from .env and crashed, so I changed tests/test_newssearch_api.py::_env to prefer os.environ.
PDF also embeds Helvetica (reportlab default for some element); harmless. The Gujarati font path was not exercised with live data (fonts are present in /app/backend/fonts).
ShareSheet handles the error state correctly with retry:false (statusQuery). Create is hidden on error.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all 5 fix areas verified; back button on reset-password broken on direct load)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ analyses for tester.newssearch (ids 2434a4fd..., 72c5298b...). Both were deleted after the UI checks and confirmed with GET 404.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with -n0 (pytest.ini adds xdist). Export SUPABASE_* from the gunicorn process env (/proc/<pid>/environ) or rely on the patched _env. test_iter3_fixes.py makes 2 Groq analyze calls; set ITER3_CLEANUP=1 to delete the created rows automatically. Migration 002 is still NOT applied, so share endpoints return 503 by design. iteration_2.json was never written; only pytest_iter2.xml exists.
rca_of_issue: header-back-button: AppHeader always calls router.back(). When /reset-password is opened from an email link (fresh load, empty stack), expo-router has nothing to pop, so GO_BACK goes unhandled. Repro: open /reset-password directly, tap the back chevron, and the URL stays the same. Mitigation: fall back to router.replace when canGoBack() is false.
